title: Znode events and outbound webhooks
summary: Domain events and webhook settings let an external system react after something changes. Events are after the fact and carry codes, not full records; a consumer or an event-triggered Data Exchange fetches the rest.
when_to_use: notify an external system when an order, account or product changes
not_for: changing the outcome of the operation (use a method override)
limitations: Delivery guarantees depend on the broker
platform_change_if: an event that does not exist for the module

unverified: event list on the customer's release
